findings.summary: Readiness accepts any current-HEAD *.qa.md or *.review.md without checking that it belongs to the milestone being signed off, so unrelated evidence from the same commit can unlock a different Agency milestone.
findings.suggested_fix: Pass a milestone/plan identity into the predicate and require matching artifact metadata; add a regression test with only unrelated same-HEAD evidence.

findings.summary: The review check treats any non-empty generator other than verify-qa and an absent negative token as a clean independent review, allowing an unrecognized producer or a review with no explicit passing verdict to grant Agency signoff.
findings.suggested_fix: Require the approved independent review generator/verdict contract (or a structured PASS field) and add negative tests for unknown generators and missing verdicts.
